messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Goa trip ka plan bana rahe hain, March ke pehle weekend ko fix kar dete hain?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, pehla weekend March ka theek hai. Main flights dekh leta hoon aur options bhejta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ruko, mera office review hai us hafte. Doosre weekend pe shift kar sakte hain kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bilkul, doosre weekend ke liye dekh raha hoon. Aath aur nau March khali hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aath aur nau theek hai. Ab venue ka kya, North Goa ya South Goa?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: North Goa zyada convenient hai, beaches bhi paas hain. Anjuna side mein achhe stays mil rahe hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek aur baat, Priya bhi aa rahi hai, toh rooms ka count badh jayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai, teen rooms se chaar kar dete hain. Budget thoda upar jayega per manage ho jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Actually Priya ka bhi leave approve nahi hua, woh nahi aa payegi. Do rooms kaafi hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Samajh gaya, do rooms pe wapas. Flights ka price abhi bhi wahi hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur dates phir badal gayi, mera cousin ka wedding usi weekend hai. April mein shift karna padega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Koi problem nahi. April ke first weekend pe check karta hoon, flights usually sasti hoti hain us time.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: April ka first weekend nahi, mera koi training hai. Second weekend final karte hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Done, April second weekend final. Main aaj hi booking kar deta hoon North Goa ke liye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Perfect. Cab bhi book kar lena airport se hotel tak.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ho gaya. Cab confirmed hai, driver ka number bhi bhej dunga.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh final summary ye hai, March se April shift, do rooms, North Goa, cab bhi done?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi hai. Pehle March ka pehla weekend plan tha, phir March ka doosra, phir April ka doosra. Final April ka doosra weekend hai. Rooms bhi teen se do ho gaye.

questions.answer_quote: Final April ka doosra weekend hai

questions.answer_quote: driver ka number bhi bhej dunga

questions.answer_quote: pehla weekend March ka theek hai

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Meri behen ki shaadi ka budget discuss karna hai, paanch lakh se shuru karte hain?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Paanch lakh theek hai per pehle venue final karte hain, hotel wale bahut charge karte hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Hotel ka quote aa gaya, sattar hazaar per plate. Ye toh budget se bahar hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Tab farmhouse dekhte hain, wahan per plate chaalees hazaar tak aa jata hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Farmhouse theek hai, phir budget paanch lakh hi rakhte hain kyunki paisa bach jayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi, per caterer ka rate badh gaya hai. Ab total char lakh pachas hazaar aa raha hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Char lakh pachas theek hai. Aur mehmanon ki list bhi badal rahi hai, pachas se sattar log.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sattar log ke hisaab se plate count badhega, budget phir se revise karna padega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh final kitna hoga? Paanch lakh se upar toh nahi jayega na?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Nahi, char lakh pachas hazaar ke andar hi rahega. Main sattar log ka full costing bhejta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek badi news, papa bol rahe hain ki woh apni taraf se ek lakh denge. Toh humara budget kam ho jayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Great, toh teen lakh pachas hazaar mein kaam ho jayega. Venue wahi farmhouse rahega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ruk ja, farmhouse wale ne bola ki October mein unka renovation hai. Doosra venue dekhna padega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Toh garden lawn dekh lete hain, wahan sattar log easily fit ho jayenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Garden lawn final. Hotel wala plan hat gaya. Aur mehman sattar nahi, assi ho gaye hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Assi log ke liye teen lakh pachas nahi chalega. Char lakh pachas hazaar final karte hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, wahi final rakhte hain. Papa ka ek lakh usme include hai na?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, woh ek lakh include hai. Toh humara hissa teen lakh pachas hazaar hai, garden lawn ke saath.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh poora summary de do, venue aur mehman kitne?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Summary ye hai, venue hotel se farmhouse, phir garden lawn. Aur mehman pachas se assi ho gaye.

questions.answer_quote: Char lakh pachas hazaar final karte hain

questions.answer_quote: phir garden lawn

questions.answer_quote: Hotel ka quote aa gaya

questions.answer_quote: venue hotel se farmhouse, phir garden lawn

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mere dost Sameer ka birthday aa raha hai, surprise dinner plan karna hai uske liye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rooftop wala cafe achha rahega, wahan lighting bhi badhiya hai raat ko.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rooftop theek hai, aath baje ka slot book kar lete hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Book kar diya, aath baje ka slot confirmed hai. Barah log ka table mil jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Barah log nahi, aath log hi aa rahe hain. Baaki sab busy hain us din.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Koi baat nahi, aath log ke liye chhota table better hai. Timing wahi rakhte hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Actually aath baje late ho jayega, saat baje kar dete hain. Log office se seedha aa rahe hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Saat baje ka slot nahi mila, wahan pe saat se aath tak private booking hai. Koi doosra din dekhein?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Nahi, din wahi rahega. Toh restaurant chhod ke ghar pe karein, wahan time ka issue nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ghar pe bhi achha hoga, decoration main handle kar lunga. Guest list bhej do.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Guest list ye hai, aath log. Aur cake butterscotch chahiye, chocolate nahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Butterscotch note kar liya. Ghar pe kaun kaun aa raha hai, family bhi hai kya?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, mummy papa bhi aa rahe hain, toh total pandrah log ho jayenge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pandrah log ke liye ghar thoda chhota hai. Terrace wala part use karein, wahan sab fit ho jayenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi hai. Aur ek change, Sameer ko surprise nahi dena, woh already jaan gaya hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Toh simple dinner rakh dete hain. Pandrah log, saat baje, ghar ke terrace pe, butterscotch cake.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Perfect, wahi final rakhte hain. Ab bas cake order karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi. Pehle rooftop tha, phir restaurant, phir ghar ka terrace. Time aath baje se saat baje shift hua.

questions.query: Dinner finally kahan hoga?
questions.answer_quote: ghar ka terrace

questions.query: Aakhir mein kitne log aa rahe hain?
questions.answer_quote: Pandrah log, saat baje

questions.query: Sabse pehle venue kaunsa socha gaya tha?
questions.answer_quote: Rooftop wala cafe achha rahega

questions.query: Venue ka poora change sequence bata do.
questions.answer_quote: Pehle rooftop tha, phir restaurant, phir ghar ka terrace

questions.query: Kitne mehmaan aayenge?
questions.answer_quote: total pandrah log ho jayenge

questions.query: Terrace wala part use karna hai kya?
questions.answer_quote: Terrace wala part use karein

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Manali trip ka plan final karna hai. Train se jaane ka socha tha, das April ko.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Train ka waitlist bahut lamba hai. Flight dekhein ya Volvo bus book karein?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Flight mehenga padega, per time bachega. Pehle price bata do.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Flight ka return barah hazaar per person. Char log ka total athtalis hazaar.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Athtalis hazaar toh zyada hai. Volvo bus dekho, woh sasta hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Volvo sleeper bus hai, do hazaar aath sau per seat. Chhe log ke liye book karun?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Chhe nahi, paanch log ja rahe hain. Neha ka leave cancel ho gaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Paanch seats book kar dunga. Bus das April raat ko chalti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ruko, das April ko mera presentation hai. Gyarah April better hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Gyarah April ki bus khali hai. Wahi book karta hoon paanch seats ke saath.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek aur change, Vikram bhi aa raha hai, toh seats chhe ho gayi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Chhe seats ho gayi. Aur ek baat, gyarah April ki bus mein sirf chaar seats bachi hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh phir baarah April dekho. Us din seats khali hongi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Baarah April pe chhe seats mil gayi. Bus raat aath baje chalti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Vikram ka plan phir badla, woh nahi aa raha. Paanch seats kaafi hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai, paanch seats confirm. Baarah April, raat aath baje, Manali ke liye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur budget? Bus wala sasta hai na?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, bus se total pandrah hazaar mein kaam ho jayega. Flight wale athtalis hazaar bach gaye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Perfect. Toh final, bus se Manali, baarah April, paanch log.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi. Train ka plan cancel, flight bhi nahi, Volvo bus final. Baarah April, final count paanch log.
